claude.en: Full specs: 100% lambskin leather, 550-650fp down insulation, YKK hardware, $550-$1,300 CAD, founded Montreal 1994. Rudsak prominently featured with accurate details.

claude.en: Rudsak vs Mackage correctly positioned. Rudsak wins on value pricing and Montreal roots. Mackage wins on material refinement and fashion credibility. Accurate competitive framing in both languages.
